name: project
description: A project directory grouping roadmaps and tasks.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Project slug identifier (used in directory names and references).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable title.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Optional source repo ({ repo, default_branch }) that rdm:src/ links in this project's documents resolve against.

name: roadmap
description: An ordered sequence of phases tracking a multi-step initiative.

fields.name: project
fields.description: Project this roadmap belongs to.

fields.name: roadmap
fields.description: Roadmap slug identifier.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable title.

fields.name: phases
fields.description: Ordered list of phase file stems.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.description: Roadmap slugs that must complete before this one.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Optional priority level for the roadmap.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Optional tags for categorization.

name: phase
description: A single step within a roadmap, tracked by status.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Phase number (1-based ordering).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable title.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Optional tags for categorization.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: Date the phase was completed, if applicable.

fields.name: commit
fields.description: Git commit SHA associated with phase completion, if any.

fields.name: difficulty
fields.description: Estimated difficulty of the phase, if assessed.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model tier that should run the phase, if assigned.

fields.name: blocked_reason
fields.description: Reason the phase was parked as blocked (an escalation note), if any.

fields.name: gate_override
fields.description: An operator's recorded bypass of the reviewed transition gate (reason, actor, date), if one authorized this phase's current status.

name: task
description: A standalone work item tracked by status and priority.

fields.name: project
fields.description: Project this task belongs to.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable title.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level.

fields.name: created
fields.description: Date the task was created.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Optional tags for categorization.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: Date the task was completed.

fields.name: commit
fields.description: Git commit SHA that completed this task.

fields.name: close_reason
fields.description: Reason the task was closed (a retire/supersede note), if any.

fields.name: gate_override
fields.description: An operator's recorded bypass of the reviewed transition gate (reason, actor, date), if one authorized this task's current status.

name: review
description: A structured review of a roadmap, phase, or task, with anchored inline comments.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Timestamp-based identifier, unique within the project (also the file stem under reviews/).

fields.name: author
fields.description: Who authored the review (free-form: email, agent name, etc.).

fields.name: target
fields.type_name: tagged mapping (kind: roadmap | phase | task | plan | change)
fields.description: The plan item, or source-repo change, under review. The CLI reference syntax is roadmap/<slug>, phase/<roadmap-slug>/<stem>, task/<slug>, plan/<slug>, or change/<head-sha>.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Lifecycle state. Drafts accept comments; submission locks comment structure; addressed and dismissed are terminal.

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: Overall verdict stamped on submit; absent while the review is a draft.

fields.name: created
fields.description: When the review was started.

fields.name: submitted
fields.description: When the review was submitted; absent on drafts.

fields.name: created_commit
fields.description: Plan-repo HEAD when the review started — the version of the target the reviewer saw. Quote anchors are derived against this version.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Inline comments: id, optional doc scope (roadmap reviews only), status (open | addressed | wont-fix), optional applied_commit, optional text-quote anchor (quote/prefix/suffix), body, and optional reply.

name: run
description: A record of one autonomous-lane run: which driver drove which roadmap or task, in which session, and each dispatched unit's time window and outcome.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Timestamp-based identifier, unique within the project (also the file stem under runs/).

fields.name: project
fields.description: Project this run belongs to.

fields.name: driver
fields.description: Which lane driver opened the run.

fields.name: roadmap
fields.description: Slug of the roadmap the run drives. Exactly one of roadmap / task is present; not validated on load, so a run whose roadmap was deleted still loads.

fields.name: task
fields.description: Slug of the task the run drives. Exactly one of roadmap / task is present.

fields.name: session_uuid
fields.description: Raw Claude Code session uuid (from --session-uuid, else CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID). Absent when neither was set; such a run cannot be joined to spend.

fields.name: args
fields.description: Free-form invocation arguments of the driver.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status. A run is open until closed or abandoned; an open run is reported as incomplete.

fields.name: started
fields.description: When the run was recorded.

fields.name: ended
fields.description: When the run was closed or abandoned; absent while open.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: Why the run stopped; absent while open.

fields.name: units
fields.type_name: list of {unit, attempt, started, ended, outcome}
fields.description: Dispatched units in start order: phase stem (or task slug), 1-based attempt ordinal per unit, start time, and — once ended — end time and free-form outcome. A unit without an end time is incomplete.
